sections.theory:
High Jump

(a) Upright

To keep the cross bar at different heights two uprights (Uprights) (poles, posts) made of iron, wood or any material are needed. It should be kept in mind that marks are placed on them to show the height and that they are strong.

The distance between the uprights (Uprights) should be at least 3.66 metres and at most 4.02 metres.

The supports (Support) for the cross bar will be of rectangular shape and their length will be 60 millimetres and breadth 40 millimetres.

(b) Cross Bar

It should be made of any metal (iron), wood or suitable material. In the middle it can be round or triangular in shape, but its edges will be of rectangular shape so that placing it on the upright (fixing) is easy.

The length of the cross bar will be at least 3.64 and at most 4 metres.

Its weight will be 2.2 kilograms.

The surface of those parts of the bar which will be placed on the supports (Support) should be smooth.

(c) Landing Area

The length of the landing area 5 metres.

The breadth of the landing area 4 metres.
